hypothesis: The symmetric SO(3) magnetic observation Jacobian depends on the current measurement noise. A predicted-field-only Jacobian is the local right-error derivative at the prior and removes that noise dependence. Test whether this reduces denied yaw/attitude bias without changing physical noise, gates, delay method or covariance policy. NIS near one does not establish optimal state error.
scope: Development ablation on known seed 911. Generated-C one-expression replacement equivalent to replacing wedge(.5*(predictedField+measuredField)) with wedge(predictedField) in magnetometerVectorObservation.mo. Not yet exported from modified Modelica; not a production change or untouched validation.
decision: Reject as a general replacement if materially worse on yaw/attitude or denied position. A promising result requires all eight existing development captures then fresh independent validation; do not tune on their noise realizations.
